newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Jan-May oil products demand up 2.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Jan-May oil products demand up 2.1 pct.

text.p: South Korea's petroleum product demand grew 2.1 percent to 319.9 million barrels in the first five months of 1997 from 313.4 million a year earlier, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy said on Friday.
This compares with a 7.6 percent gain in demand in the same period of last year, a ministry statement said.
It said the demand growth lagged on an industrial slowdown and higher product prices.
The oil refiners produced 365.1 million barrels of petroleum products in the January to May period against 286.7 million a year before.
South Korea has a refining capacity of 2.44 million bpd.
